claim.claim-text: 1. A glass composition suitable for fiber forming comprising:
2. The glass composition of claim 1, wherein a ratio of SiO<2> to Al<2>O<3>, (SiO<2>/Al<2>O<3>), ranges from about 3.6 to about 4.6.

3. The glass composition of any of claims 1 or 2, wherein a ratio of Al<2>O<3> to (Al<2>O<3>+MgO+CaO), (Al<2>O<3> /(Al<2>O<3>+MgO+CaO)), ranges from about 0.33 to about 0.47, such as ranging from about 0.35 to about 0.45 or ranging from 0.37 to 0.42, or being less than 0.40.
4. The glass composition of any of claims 1-3, wherein a ratio of CaO to MgO, (CaO/MgO), ranges from about 1.6 to about 2.8.
5. The glass composition of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the (Li<2>O + MgO + Al<2>O<3>) content ranges from about 22 up to 24 weight percent.
6. The glass composition of any one of claims 1-5, wherein the composition is substantially free of F<2>.
7. The glass composition of any one of claims 1-6, further comprising up to 0.2 weight percent Na<2>O.
8. The glass composition of any one of claims 1-7, further comprising up to 0.2 weight percent K<2>O.
9. A plurality of glass fibers formed from the glass composition of any of claims 1-8.
10. The plurality of glass fibers of claim 9, wherein the glass fibers have one or more than one or all of the following:
- a Young's modulus greater than 85 GPa, - a density less than 2.7 g/cm<3>, - a forming temperature (T<F>) of less than 1350 °C, - a liquidus temperature (T<L>) of less than 1250 °C.
a polymeric material; and a plurality of glass fibers formed from the glass composition of any of claims 1-8.
12. The polymeric composite of claim 11, wherein the plurality of glass fibers are in the form of a non-woven fabric, or wherein the plurality of glass fibers are in the form of a woven fabric.
13. The polymeric composite of any one of claims 11 or 12, wherein the polymeric material comprises a thermoplastic polymer, or wherein the polymeric material comprises a thermosetting polymer.
14. An article of manufacture comprising the plurality of glass fibers according to any of claims 9 or 10.

15. The article of manufacture according to claim 14, wherein the article of manufacture is a fiber glass strand, a chopped fiber glass strand, a roving, a yarn, a woven fabric, a nonwoven fabric or a prepreg.
